question: What was the Gross Enrollment Ratio (GER) in higher education in India according to the All India Survey on Higher Education, 2021-22?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**28.4%**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Gross Enrollment Ratio (GER)** is a statistical measure used in the education sector to determine the number of students enrolled in a particular level of education (such as higher education) as a proportion of the eligible age group population.
